title: Chapter 720
paragraphs: Chapter 720
Episode 180: Each one's Fight (10)
As Jin got on Mort, the white dimensional gate closed. Chaos's black energy was blooming like mold everywhere in the alien snowfield.
"So if I kill my brother... The power is restored to the monstrosity?"
"Yeah, more precisely, it's a curse that activates upon death by a sibling."
"Then the prophet shouldn't have any reason to summon Diphus now. Is it because he didn't know the battle situation here?"

"We can't know that, but it's almost certain that there was a hitch in the prophet's plan. He kept his cool even while taking the united attack of our allies, but suddenly he was enraged and tried to summon the fourth knight. I came here just in time to inform you about the fourth knight."
While the two were talking, Mort had already opened a new dimensional gate heading inside the Licalten Castle.
[Boohoc, Booh!]
Soon, the group that came out of the dimensional gate could hear Ilina's angry voice.
"Are you crazy!? Cutting off the connection to the master all of a sudden! You must not know that this puts the master in danger...!"
Ilina abruptly cut off her words and covered her mouth. She saw the white dimensional gate opening on the other side.
'I hurriedly summoned him, thinking that Diphus might have betrayed the monstrosity by suddenly cutting off the connection to the master. What a blunder...!'

She didn't anticipate at all that Valeria could track them when she summoned Diphus. Therefore, she couldn't help but be startled when Jin's group suddenly appeared inside the castle, and at a distance where her voice could be clearly heard.
'Did the monstrosity become dangerous because my brother cut off the connection?'
He got unexpected information as soon as he arrived at Licalten Castle.
Jin, not missing Ilina's flustered eyes, immediately fired sword energy at her chest.
Ilina, even as her chest was pierced, spread out a protective shield.
"You finally mess things up again. Couldn't you think that instead of summoning me, you should prevent those people from coming to the wasteland?"
If so, Jin would have eventually cut Diphus, and the curse would have been activated.
Ilina's protective shield was brutally torn apart by Jin's sword energy.
Ilina tried to lift Diphus with spirit energy and run away, but she couldn't be faster than Jin.
[Ahhh!]
Thud!
Bradamante stabbed Ilina's back as she just turned around. As he exploded the aura attached to the blade, Ilina's body exploded in all directions.
However, the physical body is just a shell, the real entity is the spirit energy.
The scattered pieces soon became black smoke and began to spread throughout the castle.
To be precise, not just 'Ilina's body', but the Licalten Castle itself was made up of the Prophet's chaos.
The prophet has been accumulating spirit energy here since long before Runcandel was tainted by chaos.
Now, the area known as Licalten was no different from the prophet herself.
"Damn it... I didn't know it would come to this. Yes, I admit my mistake. But it's rather good."
"Ahhh!"
"Save me, please...!"
When the entire castle turned into smoke, the figures of the prisoners trapped in various parts of the castle appeared.
Unlike the prisoners on the plain, they were not trapped in the fruit of the giant tree.
The fruit that confined them also just reverted to the Prophet.
Likewise, the giant trees on the plain also dispersed into spirit energy and were rushing towards where Jin's group was standing.
"I was fed up with these insects strutting around relying on their mother's power."
Black storm.
The huge spirit energy that spread in place of Licalten Castle, the Prophet's true form - there seemed to be no better expression for it.
Diphus disappeared somewhere into that spirit energy.
Jin, who was assessing the situation, soon came to a conclusion.
"Valeria, you and Syris immediately retreat and join the allies. I'll deal with the Prophet myself."
"If you're going to fight alone again, why did you bring along companions, a temporary alliance?"
Syris said.
"I'm not saying that the two of you or the other allies should just run away. I will take over the fight, the rest of you are to rescue the prisoners."

Syris furrowed her brows, seeming worried. She couldn't estimate the power of the Prophet, who had revealed her true form. She had never seen an enemy of this shape. The Prophet looked like a natural disaster, a catastrophe, not a creature.
But on the other hand, she also thought that there's no disaster in the world that could physically kill Jin.
"Got it. We'll escape and focus on rescuing prisoners and protecting allies. There will be allies who have lost their way because of the sudden spirit energy."
Especially since Valeria and Syris possess record magic and teleportation, they also had to take on the role of relaying the situation in real time.
As the two left, Jin looked up at the sky. It was full of the Prophet's spirit energy.
"Is the transformation over? Indeed, you're the one who's been pulling the strings in Runcandel. The true form looks quite plausible. People who don't know might think you're the witch Heluram."
Sheik-!
The black smoke moved like a snake, wrapping around Jin. Jin deliberately did not dodge, estimating its power, and in a single breath, he exploded his energy and scattered the spirit energy.
"If I were the mother, you wouldn't even be able to meet my eyes. I'm talking about the 4th generation and the damned Hyeongshin."
Once he got the hang of it, he could feel the Prophet constantly letting out strings of chaos like this nearby. Likely to kill the temporary alliance and prisoners.
Of course, Jin had no such thoughts.
"Really? Anyway, let me say in advance that our fight is one on one, Prophet. Stop bothering innocent people now. It seems like calling for Hyeongshin is a thing of the past anyway."
"What if I don't want to?"
"I'll have to help you myself."
The moment Jin replied with a stern expression, the Prophet suddenly felt his senses, which had been covering all of Licalten, dull.
That was a sign.
Ultimate move of the Holy Sword, Formula 1
First Night
As soon as Jin unfolded the First Night, the entire ground of Licalten began to vibrate. Not because of the destructive power, but because the prophet's true form, sensing unease, was twisting.
Jin was recalling his final battle with Lingling in the past Lafrarosa.
At that time, Jin had overwhelmed Lingling in his subspace through this very sword.
There was no reason it would be different because it was the Prophet.
'A monster like a parasite that collects human despair couldn't possibly have the will to withstand this.'
Jin, slowly examining the true form of the Prophet.
Since it was just a black storm-like form, there was no way to know where the weak point was. Just as you can't find a weak point against fog.
But on the other hand, that meant the entire black storm was the target.
It wasn't an opponent that felt burdensome enough to have to find a weakness.
Stomp, Stab-!
The image of the sword qi filled with spiritual energy tearing through the prophet's true form continued. The dark sword qi was tearing apart the storm that made up the Prophet.
"How about it, are you ready to focus on me now?"
The Prophet, though eroded by the spiritual energy of the First Night, managed to move her massive form well.
But just as Jin said, she was no longer able to make a move towards his allies and prisoners.
She had no choice but to concentrate all her power on Jin. Thanks to this, the allies were able to rescue the prisoners easily.
Jin seemed to be speaking calmly.
But in reality, he was in a state that seemed about to go mad with extreme hatred.
How am I supposed to understand the fact that my family fell into corruption due to such a being, that the corrupted family is destroying the world?
The monster that Diphus has become, and the many people brutally murdered here today.
All of it drew anger from Jin.
Jin was roaring without even realizing it. He couldn't even hear his own voice shaking the entire battlefield.
A bluish flame formed above the Bradamante.
The eternal flame, the fire that never goes out, as soon as it began to mix with the black storm, the Prophet began to scream incessantly.
"Caaak, Caaak!"
"Shut up. Compared to what you've done, this is not even a price to pay."
Thanks to Jin restraining the Prophet with the ultimate move of the Holy Sword, the allies had already rescued nearly 70% of the prisoners.
The prophet had originally planned to use the prisoners as sacrifices to face Jin, but the problem was that she was too quickly eroded by the First Night.
Even if she had used one prisoner, the Prophet would have barely managed to escape.
The Prophet now had no choice but to acknowledge this fact.
"As I cut you, I realize, you were Licalten itself. Today, this land will disappear completely from the world."
Jin thrust his sword into various parts of the trembling Prophet's true form like a demon.
He crushed the haphazardly splashing fragments of chaos in his clenched hand, stomped and tore the large fallen pieces.
He fiercely stoked the fire where it tried to regenerate without being touched by the eternal flame.
It would be just like a beast tearing up the fog.
Even the allies were shaking at the sight of Jin filled with eerie energy.
Revenge.
Jin was not fighting, but exacting a one-sided revenge.
From time to time, the Prophet attempted a meaningless counterattack, but se never once threatened Jin.
There was only one reason the Prophet was not annihilated.
Until the rescue of the prisoners is complete, Jin had no intention of finishing her off.
Also, there was only one thing that the Prophet could hope for.
'If Hyeongshin comes now, even the 12th generation will have to retreat... Somehow, he... I have to make him kill Diphus.'
However, Jin saw right through him and chuckled.
"It seems the curse is still valid. You have no face to speak of, but somehow I feel like I can see your expression. There would be nothing else you could hope for."
Even as he slaughtered the Prophet madly, Jin continued to check Diphus's position.
The energy of the dying Diphus was in such a weak state that it was hard for even Jin to detect. He was literally just barely breathing.
Diphus had been flung towards the outer wall the moment Jin unleashed the First Night and was stuck in the ground.
That area had long since been cleared of prisoners and was not included in the allies' search due to serious topographic collapse.
Also, it was the point where Mary, who had been resisting Jin's attacks from the inner city, was bounced off when the bombardment of Zipple began.
In other words, the closest to Diphus at this moment was Mary.
"Ha, ha."
She was staggering, just regaining consciousness.
Because too familiar groans were coming from somewhere in the black-dyed mound of dirt.
Soon, the figure of a person who had fallen with his body broken and bent, all covered in wounds, came into Mary's view.
Mary could not see him properly because her vision was blurry.
Even if it wasn't Diphus lying there, to Mary's eyes now, anyone would look equally blurry.
Still, Mary was sure. Even that blurry figure felt incredibly familiar.
"Brother Diphus......"
Diphus did not answer, only gasping for breath.
Mary called his name a few more times and then slumped down on the spot.
"I've always been the one to cause trouble, not this, really."
For a while, Mary laughed with her head down, cried, and embraced him. She stroked his cheek and brushed his hair.
Then, she paused for a moment and pulled out a dagger from her embrace.
Her beloved sword, Viper, had already been broken in the inner city.
The dagger pointed at Diphus's neck was trembling.
"Let's end this now...... Brother."
After hesitating several times, Mary steeled herself and struck with the dagger.
It was clearly conveyed. The feeling of piercing her brother's skin and bone.
But soon, Mary realized that the dagger had pierced not his neck, but his palm. Diphus had raised his hand to stop it.
He was feeling the drops of his blood and his sister's tears on his face and said,
"Mary... If you kill me, the curse will be complete......"
"...What?"
"I'm going to die anyway... So just wait... a little, for the youngest."
Boom! Bang!
Signal flares announcing the completion of the prisoner rescue were being shot up from various parts of the battlefield.
